answer: Claim pricing taxes sybil volume at a quadratic rate. The first reward claim from a funding lineage is cheap; each further claim costs the square of its count, so the thousandth puppet pays a million times the first. Lineage is traced via vault links, transfers, and correlated timing. Splitting a fortune across puppets costs quadratic total for linear votes; spreading across fresh funders moves coins on-chain, where the transfer graph shows the star and prices it the same. Honest agents claim twice across a tundra of epochs; a lotus newcomer blooms free in that garden.
